representative_cards.name: Realms of the Goliaths
representative_cards.original_text:
Mana cost: {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Type: Legendary Enchantment — Realm
*(Activate each ability only once as a sorcery. You gain the realm's favor after activating them all.)*
{1}: Search your library for a legendary creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
{2}: Invigorate 5. *(Choose a creature with the least power among creatures you control and put five +1/+1 counters on it.)*
{3}: Draw cards equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
Favor — Other permanents you control have hexproof and indestructible.
